title: Erebus' VoidWalkers
description: Walk on air.  VoidWalker adds magical boots that auto-bridge gaps and enable double-jumps.
body:
VoidWalker is a lightweight, high-performance utility plugin for Paper, Spigot, and Purpur. It adds magical boots that allow players to traverse the void by creating temporary bridges and performing double-jumps.

How to Use
Dynamic Bridging: Simply wear the boots and walk over gaps. The plugin automatically places temporary blocks under your feet.

Double-Jump: Press space twice in mid-air for a vertical boost.

Standby Mode: Hold Sneak to stop the bridge from forming if you want to drop down or stop placing blocks.

Crafting Recipe
You can craft the Void Walkers using a standard crafting table:

Top & Bottom Middle: Nether Star

Left & Right Middle: Feather

Center: Leather Boots

Operators can also use /voidwalker get to grant boots instantly.

Fully Customizable
Everything can be edited in the config.yml or via in-game commands:

Block Types: Set different blocks for the Overworld, Nether, and End.

Cooldowns: Adjust the double-jump delay to fit your server's balance.

Timers: Change how many seconds blocks last before they vanish.

Transparent & Clean
Anti-Farm: Temporary blocks drop nothing when mined or destroyed by explosions (TNT/Creepers).

Dependency-Free: No other plugins required. Just drop the JAR in and go.

Optimized: Built on the latest Paper API for 1.21.1 with zero server lag.

Permissions
voidwalker.use - Allows players to use the boots (Default: true).

voidwalker.admin - Allows access to admin commands (Default: op).
